newsitem.title: LEBANON: Guerrilla rockets wound four in south Lebanon - SLA.
newsitem.headline: Guerrilla rockets wound four in south Lebanon - SLA.

text.p: Moslem guerrillas wounded three civilians and one pro-Israeli militiaman in two rocket attacks in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone overnight, sources with the pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army (SLA) said on Wednesday.

They said one rocket hit an SLA position in Qantara village in the western sector of the zone, slightly wounding a militiaman. Another rocket hit a house in the same village, wounding a man and his daughter and son.
In Beirut, a spokesman for the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) claimed responsibility for hitting the SLA post but denounced the attack on the house.
The attack on the militia post brought to 26 the number of SLA fighters wounded by guerrillas since the beginning of 1997.
Hizbollah is fighting Israeli and SLA troops in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine-mile) -wide occupation zone.
